title: NonStationaryBrachistochrone: reproducibility package for controlled-rail brachistochrones in non-stationary spacetimes
description:
Symbolic derivations, numerical verification scripts, figure-generation code, and manuscript sources for controlled-rail brachistochrones in non-stationary spacetimes. The repository supports the companion studies of the FLRW and Vaidya sectors and of the conformal Kerr (Thakurta-Kerr) sector.

New in 1.2.0. A symbolic verification suite for the formal core of Paper I, under paper1/verification/: every algebraic step that the manuscript states as proved is re-derived independently in two computer-algebra systems (Mathematica and SymPy), each check returning an exact symbolic zero rather than a numerical tolerance. verify_paper1_core.py exits non-zero on failure and can be used as a regression gate. The suite covers the rail indicatrix and the time-dependent optical metric with Perlick's stationary metric as its limit; the reduction determinant identified as a resultant; the closed forms of the reduction coefficients; the appendix-B residues; and the conjugate-point and caustic analysis. REPRODUCTION_section4.2.md records a re-run of the archived trajectory scripts behind the phenomenology section. paper1/build_paper1.sh makes a clean checkout turnkey: it regenerates all thirteen figures from their scripts, collects them, and compiles the manuscript.
